name: xcs
description: XCS protocol specification and reference implementation for XRPL Credentials

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @xcs-protocol/core build && pnpm --filter @xcs-protocol/sdk build && XCS_BROWSER_E2E=0 XCS_LOCAL_PAYLOAD_STORE=0 pnpm --filter @xcs-protocol/web build && pnpm --filter @xcs-protocol/web test:e2e && pnpm --filter @xcs-protocol/web test:e2e:security
scripts.test:postgres: pnpm --filter @xcs-protocol/core build && pnpm --filter @xcs-protocol/db build && pnpm --filter @xcs-protocol/indexer test:postgres && pnpm --filter @xcs-protocol/api test:postgres
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
